reply.emotion: matter-of-fact and ordinary, describing a common farm animal
notes: When referring to the meat you eat rather than the living bird, Russian uses the same word курица in everyday speech, though курятина specifically means chicken meat.

senses.definition: A domestic bird kept on a farm for its eggs and meat.

examples.text: Во дворе гуляет курица с цыплятами.
examples.translation: A hen with chicks is walking in the yard.
examples.emotion: peaceful and observant, watching farm animals

senses.definition: Chicken meat prepared and served as food.

examples.text: На ужин у нас будет жареная курица.
examples.translation: We will have roast chicken for dinner.
examples.emotion: hungry and looking forward to a warm meal

definitions: A domestic bird kept on a farm for its eggs and meat.
Chicken meat prepared and served as food.
